facts.claim: Exec advances clocks, handles an event, selects PPU/counter phase using current post-event H, then syncs coprocs.
limits: Nested targets remain separately gated.

facts.claim: DRAM performs twenty nested Exec calls. Under fixed normal even phase it starts at H532/534/536/538 and returns H572/574/576/578.
limits: Requires no extra callback reentry/mutation/reset/load.

facts.claim: BeginHdmaTransfer/Init only set pending and delay flags, without copying bytes.
limits: Pending is not absence of future service.

facts.claim: CPU pending service precedes signal sampling. DMA also services at RunDma entry/after each byte and manual-DMA startup.
limits: DMA service recursion is distinct from recursion into an unfinished Exec dispatch.

facts.claim: Exec ProcessPpuCycle is debugger dispatch. SNES debugger can update viewers, stop for stepping, catch up SPC, and run NEC DSP.
limits: This callback is not RenderScanline.

facts.claim: Viewer notifications and pauses reach host subscribers and CodeBreak scripts; concrete active targets are not closed.
limits: A premise boolean cannot certify target closure.

facts.claim: No debugger object makes the wrapper inert; with a debugger, no viewers/step request/needed coprocs closes the SNES body callouts.
limits: Requires actual valid guard binding; not newly observed here.

facts.claim: Renderer executes before scanline increment and H=0. Autojoy and SPC update execute after H=0.
limits: Frame callbacks excluded only under bounded valid raster/cache premises.

facts.claim: Reviewed render-family direct calls use PPU-owned arrays and arithmetic; external paths read H or copy debugger display buffers without advancing main clock.
limits: Assumes valid objects/bounds and ordinary defined execution. Not pixel-equivalence, memory-safety or termination proof; all overload bodies matter.
DebugProcess overlay copies require the exact SNES debugger target and valid non-null PPU tools; the virtual GetPpuTools route is not closed for arbitrary debugger implementations.

facts.claim: Autojoy updates its own scheduler/controller latches and calls direct control-manager methods; those invoke device ReadRam/WriteRam virtually.
limits: Scalar caller does not advance main clock; runtime virtual types remain gated.
Automatic reads pass forAutoRead=true, excluding the ordinary read branch that invokes debugger break and ProcessAutoJoypad again.

facts.claim: For exact SnesController dynamic type, ReadRam/WriteRam reaches local shift/strobe state and RefreshStateBuffer/ToByte. Button reads use locks, capacity checks and inherited HasCoordinates=false before indexing stored state; these reviewed bodies do not advance the main clock.
limits: Does not close every BaseControlDevice subclass; requires exact dynamic type.
Requires valid objects, defined standard-library allocation/indexing and ordinary synchronization behavior; lock acquisition is not a termination or host-mutation proof.

facts.claim: Active control-device vector and all transitive targets are not certified. Rumble reaches force-feedback; multitap reaches controller-hub methods.
limits: Do not transfer ordinary-controller proof to mouse/scope/rumble/hub without target audit.

facts.claim: Fixed cached VBlank start225 and scanlines119..211 make UpdateSpcState perform no SPC call and leave inOverclockedScanline false regardless raw SETINI bits.
limits: Debugger and register-bus SPC paths remain separate.

facts.claim: Spc::Run reads main clock as target for SPC-local cycles but can invoke instruction/debugger hooks and DSP execution.
limits: No complete DSP/audio/debugger target closure attempted. SPC-local cycles are not main clock.

facts.claim: SyncCoprocessors is inert when needCoprocSync is false. Initialization sets it true for SA1/GSU/CX4/SGB.
limits: Actual target/guard binding required; game title alone is not a certificate.

facts.claim: Enabled SyncCoprocessors calls virtual BaseCoprocessor::Run, whose selected implementations are outside this packet.
limits: Inspect actual target or refuse.

facts.claim: SETINI changes raw ExtBg/HiRes/Overscan/ObjInterlace/ScreenInterlace and converts output buffers; no timing-cache refresh occurs in this write.
limits: Renderer executes before register mutation; not visually inert.

facts.claim: PowerOn and line-zero completion call UpdateNmiScanline; it derives VBlank225/240 and frame end from mode/region/odd frame/settings.
limits: Method is public: this is not complete external-callsite closure; reset/load/direct host calls remain excluded.

facts.claim: Under valid fixed cache and no external refresh/reset/load, SETINI writes do not directly change the pinned cache values or the 1364-clock line-length predicate within lines119..211. The live interlace short-line condition requires line240.
limits: Not DMA-input lifetime, image-equivalence or later-frame proof.
Preservation of the complete IRQ/NMI schedule still requires the separate callback and bus-mutation premises.

facts.claim: RegisterHandlerB routes2133 to PPU Write rather than SPC2140..217F or WRAM2180..2183.
limits: Requires actual mapping to this handler.

facts.claim: RamHandler Read/Write are direct mapped-byte array operations with no external callout.
limits: Does not establish actual handler mapping or outer wrappers.

facts.claim: ReadDma/WriteDma advance clocks, resolve virtual memory handlers and invoke cheat/debugger wrappers.
limits: Actual map/hook closure and fixed register premises remain separate.

facts.claim: With concrete closed/absent callback branches and bus/host mutation excluded, only DRAM nests unfinished Exec dispatch and returns H572..578. Service may end at H6/H10 without duplicating unfinished Exec phase.
limits: Conditional implication only. Does not certify premises or accept an arbitrary nonmutating callback class.

facts.claim: PPU callback is after phase selection; coprocessor sync is after both phase branches. Reentry there alone does not rerun the outer counter branch.
limits: An ancestor event frame can still matter; reentry is not proved harmless.
